instruction: Intimate indoor medium close-up of a couple relaxing together. In the foreground, the woman in the white shirt (R1) sits leaning back with her eyes closed and a peaceful smile, wearing a black camisole underneath. Behind her, the man in the beige t-shirt (R2) cradles her in his lap, resting his head gently against hers. They are positioned in a cozy room in front of a fireplace. Warm, soft side lighting casts a golden glow over the scene, enhancing the intimate, relaxed, and comfortable atmosphere.
